title: Thread: AI Journal & Memory - Apps on Google Play
excerpt: Capture thoughts with an ai journal that connects ideas to build your second.
content_html:
Thread is a private AI journal that remembers with you. Instead of just storing notes in isolated folders, it connects each new thought with relevant memories from your past, helping you rediscover ideas, spot recurring themes, and understand how your thinking changes over time.

A Quiet Second Brain

Most note-taking apps help you store information. Thread helps you understand it. It works like a second brain, quietly keeping the context for you without demanding constant organization with folders or tags. The system becomes a personal memory map that grows and evolves with you.

• Capture thoughts in seconds: Type a journal entry, save a quick idea, or record a voice note whenever something is on your mind.
• Forget manual organizing: Thread automatically finds semantic connections between what you've captured and things you've thought about before.
• See the bigger picture: Understand how isolated notes contribute to larger ideas, helping you follow your thinking as it develops organically.
• Build a personal memory system: The more you add, the easier it becomes to return to previous thoughts and continue where you left off.

A Journal That Builds Context

Your best ideas often appear as fragments: a sentence before bed, a question you keep returning to, a voice note on a walk. This unique AI journal is designed to keep those fragments connected, so you can find your way back to them and see how they fit together.

• Follow your train of thought: When you open a memory, you'll see a list of connected past memories, allowing you to trace an idea's origins.
• See how threads are formed: Your connected thoughts feed into active threads, with quotes from your memory showing how a larger theme was built.
• Get a daily insight: Each day, Thread surfaces a thought worth revisiting, like a pattern or theme that keeps appearing in your memories.
• Visualize your thinking: See recent memories and insights appear as stars on an orbital canvas, giving you a unique spatial overview of your recent thoughts.

For The Way Your Mind Actually Works

This tool is built for thinkers, creators, and anyone who wants to make sense of their own ideas. It's especially useful when you are in the middle of a complex thought process, developing something new, or trying to understand yourself better.

• Think through a decision: Lay out all the angles and let the app connect related considerations you've captured over time for a clearer view.
• Develop a project: Track the evolution of a business, creative work, or personal project from its earliest sparks of inspiration.
• Journal for self-reflection: Use it as a daily voice journal or text journal to spot recurring themes and understand how your thinking changes over time.
• Capture fleeting ideas: Save thoughts while walking or working, knowing the context will be saved and connected for you later.

Private By Design

We believe your thoughts should always remain yours. Your privacy is a fundamental part of the design, not an afterthought. This is an AI journal you can trust completely with your most important ideas.

• Your data is never for sale: Your notes and voice captures are used only to provide Thread's features for you, and never for advertising.
• AI models don't train on you: We do not use your private entries to train our or any third-party AI models. Your thoughts stay yours.
• You are always in control: Delete an individual capture or your entire account at any time, directly from within the app.
• Your information is protected: All of your data is secured with strong encryption both in transit and at rest on our servers.

Get Started Easily

There's no complicated setup. Start capturing thoughts right away and see how our AI journal helps you connect the dots in your own thinking. The free plan is a generous and powerful way to begin building your personal memory system.

• Start for free: Capture up to 8 memories per day and record voice notes up to 3 minutes long.
